feasibility_reasoning:
The core mechanism works. Priority comes from BuilderRenderer.tsx:381 (aboveFold = index < 3) and is consumed only in PostListView.tsx:298/545/580/700, WidgetView.tsx:492 and mediaWidgets.tsx:211/225. Sliders use an unconditional priority at sliderVariants.tsx:1203/1423/1567/1711/1847. OptimizedImage.tsx:121/125/130 gives priority=false the values lazy and fetchpriority=auto, so React emits no auto-preload for those images. A candidate computed from the doc alone keeps SSR and hydration in parity: the client hydrates from the dehydrated doc, which is guest-stripped on SSR (queries/public.ts:124-127). Chunks and gates are safe: BuilderRenderer, heroImage.ts, postListQuery, sliderFallbackQuery and imageSlot are already in the entry chunk assets/index-DPN2YAij.js (reports/chunk-inventory.json), so no new import edge appears and check:chunks / check:entry-purity are not at risk.

The design is under-specified in several places that decide correctness:
(1) A page has many BuilderRenderer instances: Footer.tsx:120 (default window 3), Header.tsx:271, MobileDrawerBody.tsx:33, PopupHost.tsx:240, ContentRenderer, HomeBuilderContent and TaxonomyPage. A candidate per renderer gives several data-lcp-candidate / high images per page.
(2) The 'largest desktop slot share' rule ignores column order.mobile (types.ts:512-513; imageSlot.ts:18-31 computes desktop and tablet only). It is right on '/' only because the hero column has order mobile 1 (homepageTemplate.ts:95,118). Elsewhere the mobile LCP image, eager+high today, becomes lazy.
(3) 'Section 0 only + skip abTest' returns null for a hero in section 1, and for an A/B pair at index 0, even though SSR deterministically shows variant A (experiments.ts:94-101). Today both cases are eager.
(4) builderHeroPreload (heroImage.ts:250-275) still preloads the DOM-first 25vw card (routes/index.tsx:236/255/311, routes/$.tsx:669/673/814). With LP-1 alone that card is lazy but still preloaded High, and the verification of a single preload link fails.
(5) Tests encoding the old contract are missing from the gate list: builderRenderer.streaming.test.tsx:137-166, mediaWidgetsBranches.test.tsx:163-174, homeRoute.test.tsx:608.
blocking_issues: Several BuilderRenderer instances per page (Footer.tsx:120, Header.tsx:271 chrome, MobileDrawerBody.tsx:33, PopupHost.tsx:240, ContentRenderer, HomeBuilderContent, TaxonomyPage). lcpCandidate needs an opt-in owner prop on the primary content renderer only; otherwise 'single candidate per document' and the LP-3 marker break.

The candidate rule uses desktop slot share only and ignores column order.mobile (types.ts:512-513). Layouts where the desktop-largest widget is not first on mobile would make the mobile LCP image lazy, a regression from today's eager window for sections 0-2. Include the mobile paint order, or allow at most 2 candidates.

'Section 0 only, skip abTest' can return null. Scan the visible sections in variant-A semantics within ABOVE_FOLD_SECTION_COUNT, using the same filters as SectionsList (BuilderRenderer.tsx:363-368), and take the first section with an image-bearing widget.

builderHeroPreload (heroImage.ts:250-275) must be switched to lcpCandidate in the same change, or LP-1 must ship atomically with LP-2. Otherwise the head imagePreloadLink and the Link header keep fetching a now-lazy 25vw card at High, and the verification count(link preload fp=high)==1 fails (it would be 2).
Tests that must be rewritten on purpose are not listed: builderRenderer.streaming.test.tsx:137-166 (eager x3), mediaWidgetsBranches.test.tsx:163-174, homeRoute.test.tsx:608.
effect_reasoning:
Lantern (trace_engine LargestContentfulPaint.js:19-55, FirstContentfulPaint.js:93-118) drops every network node whose endTime is later than observed LCP, except the document. The LCP estimate is the latest end time among nodes that are not Low images.

Desktop, prod-desktop.json: observed LCP is 3722 ms. The 640w High image (3570 to 5705) and the 480w High image (3405 to 3769) both end after it, so neither is in the optimistic or the pessimistic graph. Removing them changes Lantern LCP by 0 ms, not by up to -0.03 s. Desktop LCP stays at 1043 ms (score 0.938).

Mobile, prod-mobile.json: only one High cover loads (768w, 37.9 KB, 2861 to 3228 ms), against observed LCP 3303 ms. The other covers are Low lazy requests starting at 3589 ms or later. Today's effect is therefore 0, which confirms the claim.

Insurance case (lead covers become distinct):
- Each extra eager High lead is discovered with the hero and ends before observed LCP on a fast observed network, so it stays in both graphs.
- It adds 25-38 KB at about 195 KB/s (5-6 ms/KB), so +0.15-0.23 s per lead.
- Six leads would add +0.9-1.4 s. That is an upper bound: it needs every widget to lead with a different post, and today all of them lead with the newest post.
- Score impact, on the mobile LCP curve (p10 2.5 s, median 4.0 s, weight 25):
  - today, 5.4 s rising to 6.3-6.8 s costs 2.4-3.3 points;
  - after C3 on the fixture, 1.67 s rising to 2.6-3.1 s costs 2.6-5.7 points;
  - after C3 at a PSI-like 2.5 s, rising to 3.4-3.9 s costs 5.7-9.3 points.

A cheaper change gives about 4/6 of this insurance at effort S: keep the prefetch window at 3, set priority = aboveFold && sectionIndex === 0, and gate slider priority on aboveFold. LP-1's unique value is the single data-lcp-candidate marker for LP-3 and the single preload source (with LP-2), not score points today.
corrected_estimate: Today: mobile 0 ms / 0 points; desktop 0 ms / 0 points. The 640w and 480w High requests end after observed LCP (5705 and 3769 ms, against 3722 ms), so Lantern already excludes them. Head image preloads only go from 5 to 1 (plus the logo) if LP-2 or the builderHeroPreload fix lands in the same change. Insurance: about +0.15-0.23 s mobile LCP avoided per distinct-cover lead, +0.9-1.4 s at most for all six. That is worth 2.4-3.3 points today and 2.6-9.3 points after C3. It is a valid precondition for LP-3 only with a single page-level owner renderer.
better_alternative: If only the insurance is wanted: an effort-S change (keep the prefetch window at 3, set priority = aboveFold && sectionIndex === 0, gate slider priority on aboveFold) removes 4 of the 6 extra High leads. If LP-1 is kept, put lcpCandidate in a pure module (imageSlot plus types only) and give it an owner prop on the primary content renderer. It should scan visible variant-A sections within the window, respect column order.mobile, and also feed builderHeroPreload. Ship it atomically with LP-2.
